newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: CS, WINTERTHUR TO HOLD BRIEFING.
newsitem.headline: CS, WINTERTHUR TO HOLD BRIEFING.

text.p: Credit Suisse Group and Winterthur Group said they will hold a joint news conference at 1:30 p.m. (1130 GMT) on a planned merger announced earlier on Monday.
The media briefing will be held at Winterthur's head office in Wintherthur, north of Zurich.
CS Group also said a presentation to analysts would be held at 10:30 a.m. (0830 GMT) at Winterthur headquarters, north of Zurich.
A telephone conference for analysts based in London would follow at 12:00 p.m. (1000 GMT), the bank group said.
The merger requires approval of shareholders of both concerns and regulatory approval.
